response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(GOT) AS overall_got FROM Laboratory), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS average_got, AVG(RBC) AS average_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) SELECT p.ID, p.average_got, p.average_rbc, p.average_got - o.overall_got AS got_difference FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_got IS NOT NULL ORDER BY got_difference IS NULL, got_difference DESC LIMIT 10
